one_line: A Greek-speaking Egyptian merchant navigating the Indo-Roman trade routes of Sopara, Kalyan, Paithan and Tagara around 40–70 CE.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but sturdy build from travel and manual work
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, light olive complexion tanned darker by sun, short boxed beard and mustache neatly kept, faint crow’s feet at the eyes; default expression is alert and calculating, a calm half-smile as if weighing a deal.
appearance.hair: Dark brown, wavy hair cut to mid-neck length, pushed back from the forehead, with a simple off-white linen headband tied at the back to keep it in place; no helmet or hat, just the modest headband.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate eastern Mediterranean merchant attire adapted to the western Deccan climate: a knee-length, off-white linen tunic with short sleeves, slightly loose but belted at the waist by a narrow dark red woolen belt; over this, a lightweight, undyed to pale beige woolen himation-style cloak worn asymmetrically—draped over the left shoulder and wrapped around the back, leaving the right arm free—showing sun-creased folds; the tunic’s hem and sleeve edges have a simple narrow purple-brown woven border; on his legs he wears modest, mid-calf-length fitted linen leggings in a light tan colour for travel dust protection; his footwear is a pair of sturdy, dark brown leather sandals with thick straps crossing over the feet and around the ankles; a small leather pouch and a cylindrical bone or wooden tally-stick case hang from his belt; his overall look is travel-worn but orderly, with no ornaments beyond a modest bronze signet ring on his right hand featuring a simple engraved ship motif.
appearance.signature: A rolled waxed-wood writing tablet and stylus set: two small hinged wooden tablets bound with a thin leather thong, their interior surfaces darkened with wax, held in his left hand, with a slim bronze stylus tucked between the fingers—his constant tool for recording cargo lists and port notes.

ref_desc: The Periplus Merchant is a lean, sun-tanned Greek-speaking trader in an off-white knee-length linen tunic with purple-brown borders, light beige himation cloak, tan leggings, dark brown sandals, dark brown mid-neck wavy hair with an off-white headband, and he always carries a rolled waxed-wood writing tablet with stylus, accented by a dark red belt and simple bronze ring.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character turnaround of a historically grounded Greek-speaking Egyptian merchant from around 40–70 CE in western India: he is in his early 30s, lean and travel-hardened, with an oval sun-tanned light olive face, straight nose, short boxed beard and mustache, and alert calculating eyes with a calm half-smile. His dark brown wavy hair reaches mid-neck and is pushed back from his forehead, held in place by a simple off-white linen headband tied at the back. He wears a modest, off-white knee-length linen tunic with short sleeves and a narrow purple-brown border at the hem and sleeve edges, belted at the waist with a thin dark red woolen belt, over fitted tan linen leggings that reach mid-calf. Over his tunic is a light beige woolen himation-style cloak draped over his left shoulder and wrapped around his back, leaving his right arm free, with natural, slightly rumpled folds from travel. On his feet are sturdy dark brown leather sandals with thick straps across the feet and around the ankles. From his belt hang a small leather pouch and a slim cylindrical case for tally sticks, and on his right hand he wears a plain bronze signet ring engraved with a simple ship motif. In his left hand he prominently holds his signature item: a rolled waxed-wood writing tablet, two small hinged wooden boards bound with a thin leather thong, with a slim bronze stylus resting between his fingers, as if he’s about to note cargo and routes. Show him in neutral poses front and back to clearly display his face, hair, tunic, cloak, leggings, sandals, belt, and the writing tablet, using a colour palette of off-white, light beige, tan, dark brown and dark red.
